title: aspidium ellipticum
intro: Aspidium ellipticum, commonly known as the elliptical lady fern, is a type of fern plant belonging to the genus Aspidium. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, and alleviating respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Aspidium ellipticum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
